title: Tech Note: Transmit Base64-Encoded Content in 4D Mobile Method
version: 15 (built with 4D v14 R5 and Wakanda Enterprise 10)
author: Xiang Liu, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note is tied directly to the original 4D Mobile + Wakanda architecture, which 4D has since fully discontinued in favor of ORDA-based REST and Qodly web/mobile app tooling; both the Wakanda server product and native 4D Mobile apps no longer exist in current 4D. The general Base64 encode/decode technique for shuttling binary data through JSON/REST APIs remains valid and is still how binary payloads are handled in modern ORDA REST responses, but the specific client/server code shown is obsolete.
related_updates: 4D Mobile (native iOS/Android via Wakanda) fully discontinued
ORDA REST APIs and Qodly now used for building modern web/mobile front-ends against 4D data
Base64 remains the standard technique for binary payloads in REST/JSON generally
